# technitium_settings_recursion (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_recursion` manages, without managing it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `locally_served_dns_zones` (Boolean) Answer [locally served zones](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6303/) and [special-use domain names](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6761/) locally, so their queries don't leak to the root servers.
- `qname_minimization` (Boolean) Send name servers only as much of the query name as they need ([draft-ietf-dnsop-rfc7816bis-04](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-dnsop-rfc7816bis-04)). Technitium's default is `true`.
- `randomize_name` (Boolean) Randomize the letter case of query names over UDP ([draft-vixie-dnsext-dns0x20-00](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-vixie-dnsext-dns0x20-00)). Technitium's default is `true`.
- `recursion` (String) Who may use recursive resolution: `Deny`, `Allow`, `AllowOnlyForPrivateNetworks` or `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL`.
- `recursion_network_acl` (List of String) The networks that may use recursive resolution when `recursion` is `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL`. Each entry is an IP address or network; prefix it with `!` to deny it. Entries are checked in order, and anything unmatched is denied except loopback. An empty list clears it.
- `resolver_concurrency` (Number) The number of name servers the recursive resolver queries at the same time.
- `resolver_max_stack_count` (Number) The maximum stack depth of the recursive resolver.
- `resolver_retries` (Number) The number of retries of the recursive resolver.
- `resolver_timeout` (Number) The timeout in milliseconds of the recursive resolver.
